description: This file implements synchronization mechanisms for flash operations in the Bluetooth controller on Nordic Semiconductor hardware, utilizing Zephyr RTOS tickers and semaphores.

methods.name: ticker_stop_work_cb
methods.description: Callback to stop work ticker and signal semaphore.

methods.name: ticker_stop_prepare_cb
methods.description: Callback to stop prepare ticker before flash operation.

methods.name: time_slot_callback_work
methods.description: Handles execution of flash work during a timeslot.

methods.name: time_slot_delay
methods.description: Starts a delayed ticker for aborting radio or flash work.

methods.name: time_slot_callback_abort
methods.description: Handles aborting radio state and scheduling flash work.

methods.name: time_slot_callback_prepare
methods.description: Prepares for flash operation, possibly aborting radio.

methods.name: nrf_flash_sync_set_context
methods.description: Sets the timing context for flash synchronization.

methods.name: nrf_flash_sync_exe
methods.description: Executes synchronized flash operation with timing control.

methods.name: nrf_flash_sync_is_required
methods.description: Checks if flash sync is required based on ticker initialization.

methods.name: nrf_flash_sync_get_timestamp_begin
methods.description: Records the start timestamp for flash sync.

methods.name: nrf_flash_sync_check_time_limit
methods.description: Checks if the current time exceeds a limit during flash sync.
